rationale: Y directly engages the actual human-reviewer touchpoints: it explicitly verifies via git history that the musa.inc.md/quickstart.md 'do not change this' feedback was correctly reverted, and it raises a substantive, well-evidenced concern (RC branch pin inconsistency) at the exact npu.inc.md line where the PTAL/LGTM exchange occurred — X never mentions either file and only validates the NPU block without scrutiny. Both reviews are grounded and free of obvious fabrication, but Y's findings are more numerous, cross-checked against multiple files (Dockerfiles, mkdocs config, version.py), and come with concrete suggested text/verification commands, giving it higher actionability without padding.
